title: test_weakened
description: One commit of a merged PR deleted or weakened tests (removed assertions, || true, skips and the like), as callum-flow-test-weakening flagged it. Advisory; one event per flagged commit, restored ones included. Written by: callum-flow-merge, after the merge. Applied after the envelope by event.schema.json.

head.description: The merged PR head (the flagged commit is in the note).

note.description: Legacy machine-read note: the pipeline step, the flagged commit, whether it was restored, what kinds of weakening and which test files (last, unescaped). Read by callum-flow-evaluate, metrics 5b. Frozen until it moves into a payload (docs/events.md, Legacy notes).
